name: Should You Hire a General Contractor or a Bathroom Specialist?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a general contractor or a bathroom specialist for a remodel?
mainEntity.text: Should I hire a general contractor or a bathroom specialist for a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you hire a general contractor or a bathroom specialist depends on the scope of the project. If the remodel is concentrated in one bathroom and involves waterproofing, tile, plumbing, and finish details, a contractor with strong bathroom-specific experience can be a good fit. If the project is part of a larger home renovation that includes multiple rooms or structural work, a broader general contractor may be more efficient. What matters most is not the title but the contractor’s track record with projects like yours. Ask to see recent bathroom work, not just general portfolio images. You want someone who understands shower waterproofing, fixture placement, inspection timing, and how to coordinate plumbing and electrical trades. In Los Angeles County, local permit familiarity is also important. The right choice is the contractor who can clearly explain the process, handle the details, and manage the work without making the project feel improvised.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire the contractor whose experience best matches your project. A bathroom specialist may be stronger on waterproofing, tile, and layout details, while a general contractor may be better for projects that involve multiple rooms or broader home improvements. The key is proven experience with bathrooms, permits, and subcontractor coordination.
